construction_fencing: Fibrous inner bark woven into strong ropes and mats.
firewood: Soft fibrous wood rarely used as fuel due to high moisture.
cultural_spiritual: Sacred gathering site; trees often preserved near homesteads.
ritual: Ceremonial offerings placed at trunk base for ancestral protection.
crafts_tools: Seed pods carved into containers and fishing floats.
other_uses: Bark fiber used for weaving bags and traditional baskets.

places_found: Arid rocky granite outcrops and shallow mountain soils across Zimbabwe

food_nutrition: Aromatic tonic tea steeped in hot water.
firewood: Twigs ignite quickly even when bone dry, used for kindling.
cultural_spiritual: Symbolizes resilience and ancestral rebirth in traditional folklore.
ritual: Used in steam ceremonies for personal upliftment and spiritual clearing.
crafts_tools: Insect-repelling smoke when burned inside granaries.
other_uses: Essential oils evaluated for skincare and cosmetics.

places_found: Cultivated nationwide in warm homestead gardens and community irrigation schemes
description: Fast-growing deciduous tree cultivated for its highly nutritious leaves and nutrient-dense seed pods.

construction_fencing: Fast-growing living fence posts around garden perimeters.
firewood: Soft wood used for light domestic kindling.
